name: Spectra
review:
Spectra is a 30-line light-show slot with stacked, nudging wilds and respins.

Thunderkick rates it Medium volatility, with a 2,400x cap and a 96.4% RTP.

The nudging stacked wilds and respins give the game a hypnotic, steady rhythm, matched by its light-show visuals and synth soundtrack. A 96.4% RTP and medium volatility make it a calm, long-session choice.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
